tasks.short: Communicate with the sewer maintenance crew

steps.what: Communicate with supervisors and other workers by wireless phone or radio about the actual job and changing site conditions

tasks.design: Keep live crew communication on {TELEPHONY}. A job status screen may assist other tasks, but does not remove clarification of changing site conditions in this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: Messages depend on the actual situation and crew understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Native communication tools already connect the crew.
tasks.still_hard: Confirm an instruction was understood in noisy or changing conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when the crew needs clarification or an immediate stop.

ambition.what: No capacity gain from replacing this exchange.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live worksite radio exchanges require contextual clarification between crew members.

assumptions: Boundary is the actual phone or radio exchange. The statement does not establish a report, independent message send or record write; explicit work records are separately modeled.
No structured input or new capture required. Native job-status views were considered but do not replace this live exchange.
No change means zero upkeep; the full retained share describes the task boundary, not measured minutes.
unknowns: Whether local radio exchanges include a separately authored dispatch message
research_questions: Observe whether any actual record or dispatch action is performed separately from live talk.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Live crew exchanges remain fully retained; work-record savings are modeled separately.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep records of completed sewer maintenance and repairs

steps.what: Enter the actual job, asset, maintenance or repair action, materials and observations from completed work
inputs: worker's actual completed work and observations

steps.what: Prepare the maintenance record with job references and completed-action fields
Check that the complete record describes the actions actually taken and select the final entry
inputs: worker's actual completed work and observations

steps.what: Save the checked work record in the same maintenance system

tasks.design: Configure the native job form in {OPS_SYSTEM} to reuse the assigned job and asset identifiers and format entered work details. The worker supplies actual actions and checks the complete entry before saving it; the job plan never becomes evidence that a repair happened.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated job references and unstructured entry make records cumbersome.
tasks.enabler_now: Native job-linked forms can reuse existing identifiers and field layouts.
tasks.still_hard: Capture an accurate account of concealed conditions and incomplete repairs.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish what was planned from what the crew actually did.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-6; field access and applicable staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: maintenance systems can link work records to assigned jobs and assets using native forms.

assumptions: Boundary is preparing and keeping actual maintenance records, including capture, composition, check and save. Physical repair work is not counted in this record-writing task.

Dispatcher supplies assigned job and asset IDs; the worker supplies action taken, materials, date and actual observations in s1. Missing fields require manual entry; no hidden structured observation source is assumed.
Test native forms first. Shares and reductions are provisional scenarios, not observed baselines. s3 is the existing correctness check on the work entry, not an added supervisory approval.
The same-system save is 1% fully retained. Gross 9 minus upkeep 0.5 leaves 8.5 net; resolve shared capture with map updates rather than summing duplicates.
unknowns: Current job-form configuration and actual repeated-entry effort
research_questions: Does job-linked entry reduce composition time while preserving incomplete-work details?

already_counted.description: Complete and check the actual maintenance entry

incremental.description: Maintain action choices and form fields

approvals.approved_version: checked final maintenance record from s3; edits require renewed check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if forms already reuse identifiers; up to 6% where record assembly improves less than central 8.5% net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Update sewer maps and manhole charts

steps.what: Compare field measurements and observed sewer or manhole changes with the existing map and chart
inputs: existing sewer map and manhole chart

steps.what: Edit sewer-map geometry and manhole-chart attributes in the geographic information system
outputs: complete map and manhole-chart change draft

steps.what: Verify the complete proposed map and chart corrections against the field evidence
inputs: complete map and manhole-chart change draft
outputs: verified final map and chart change set

steps.what: Commit the verified map and chart changes within the same geographic information system
inputs: verified final map and chart change set
outputs: updated sewer map and manhole chart

tasks.design: Configure native attribute forms and geometry validation in the geographic information system {OTHER}. The worker enters evidence-backed corrections, checks the complete map and chart change set and commits it; software does not infer hidden pipe locations.
tasks.previous_blocker: Map edits repeat attribute entry and require consistency checks.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic forms and topology checks assist editing.
tasks.still_hard: A field observation may not resolve the true underground connection.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize uncertain location evidence and avoid asserting an unverified connection.

reach.learn: Coordinate reference systems and topology validation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: geographic information systems offer attribute forms and geometry checks; these do not establish underground facts.

assumptions: OTHER is the geographic information system. Boundary is map and chart updating, including evidence comparison; new surveying is not silently added or automated.

Field crew supply asset ID, observed attribute, location, measurement method and date as actual field evidence; s1 checks the evidence and manually identifies corrections. Missing evidence stops the correction, rather than generating coordinates.

Native forms and topology validation first. Editing and checking shares are unmeasured scenarios. Verify actual evidence-capture ownership with the maintenance-record task to avoid duplicate roll-up credit.
Same-system commit has 1% fully retained. Gross 10 minus 1 upkeep gives 9 net. s3 is map verification after all edits exist, not a separate approval ceremony.
unknowns: Actual map-editing permissions and current native tooling
research_questions: Do configured forms reduce map editing without turning approximate observations into asserted geometry?

already_counted.description: Edit review and final evidence comparison

incremental.description: Maintain asset attributes and validate geographic form changes

approvals.approved_version: verified final map and chart change set from s3; any edit voids check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero if native forms already suffice; up to 6% when field-evidence checking offsets more editing benefit than the central 9% net scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Requisition suitable sewer-maintenance tools and equipment

steps.what: Identify the tools and equipment needed for the actual sewer maintenance job
Check existing stock and the approved equipment catalogue
outputs: selected catalogue items and required quantities

steps.what: Prepare the tool and equipment requisition with selected item references and job details
inputs: selected catalogue items and required quantities

steps.what: Check specifications, quantities and destination on the completed requisition and authorize its submission
outputs: checked final internal equipment requisition and destination

steps.what: Submit the checked equipment requisition to the internal purchasing queue
inputs: checked final internal equipment requisition and destination

tasks.design: Configure a native catalogue-linked requisition in {PROCUREMENT} to reuse the worker's selected item references and job details. The worker checks the complete request before submitting it to purchasing; the tool does not place supplier orders on the worker's behalf.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated item descriptions and job details complicate requisition preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue lines and request templates can reuse existing fields.
tasks.still_hard: Select equipment suitable for the actual site conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize compatibility and practical handling requirements.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procurement systems can reuse catalogue references in internal requisitions while retaining human equipment selection.

assumptions: Model the requisition route expressly allowed by the statement. Boundary ends at internal submission; purchasing's supplier commitment is not counted or automated.

Purchasing maintains catalogue item ID, description and unit; stock owners maintain available quantities. Worker selects required item and quantity in s1-s2. Missing items require manual description within s3, not invented structured stock data.
Native requisitions first. Shares are provisional and must be measured; final request checking is part of ordinary preparation, with no new approval role added.
Internal submit takes 1% fully retained and earns no saving. Gross 12.25 minus 0.5 upkeep leaves 11.75 net; any edit after s4 invalidates submission authorization.
unknowns: Actual catalogue coverage and request route
research_questions: Does native catalogue reuse reduce requisition preparation without wrong quantities or equipment substitutions?

already_counted.description: Complete and verify the itemized requisition

incremental.description: Flag changed catalogue entries and request-form defects

approvals.approved_version: checked final requisition and internal destination from s4; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Zero where catalogue reuse already exists; up to 8% if exceptions reduce the central 11.75% net scenario.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Field judgement and crew communication remain with the worker; native forms reduce repeated record and requisition entry.
reach: Prepare evidence-backed corrections for a mapping technician
skills_to_grow: Check asset identifiers and geographic attributes
Record actual maintenance rather than planned work
role.ambitious_version: More reliable asset and work records while the crew retains site decisions.

job.title: Septic Tank Servicers and Sewer Pipe Cleaners
